Synopsis:
A biographical profile of Mette-Marit, Norway's new queen, tracing her path from commoner and single mother to royal spouse. Covers early media scrutiny, her personal development, royal duties, and a turbulent 2026 marked by the Epstein email scandal (denting monarchy approval ratings), her son Marius's rape conviction, and her own lung transplant following chronic pulmonary fibrosis — all unfolding as her husband King Haakon ascended the throne.
